{{Quote|He's got one of those street names, Wire. He's a Bothan, fairly short for his species with a pale fur. You should be able to find him in the Dearic cantina.|[[Veega Madish]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:Gc" />}}
'''Wire''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] who lived on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Our intel points to an information broker in Dearic, Talus. He was seen with the pilot about a week ago. Find out what he knows and see if you can track down the pilot.|[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Jevan Monsul|Monsul]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:Gc" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Wire resided in the city of [[Dearic/Legends|Dearic]], on the planet Talus, and frequented the local [[Dearic Cantina|cantina]].<ref name="SWG:Gc" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] by the name [[Cal Handro]] came to the Bothan because he was trying to get information on who was out to kill him. Wire discovered that the pilot was wanted dead by [[Trussk]], a slavemaster of the [[Blackscale Clan/Legends|Blackscale Clan]] who considered that Handro was interfering in their business by shipping [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] for a rival [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] clan. A few days after Wire talked to him,<ref name="SWG:Gc" /> the smuggler was shot down above [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] moon of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] and disappeared. Spacers recruited by both the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] quickly started to search for the missing pilot.<ref name="SWG:MD">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=other}}Quest: "Man Down!"</ref> The spacers eventually encountered Wire in the Dearic Cantina. The Bothan information broker accepted to share information about Cal Handro but first requested them to help him with a job. The spacers therefore traveled to the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] and successfully defended the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] of a smuggler working for Wire against attacks from [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. In exchange, the Bothan gave the location of [[Trussk's house|Trussk's fortress]] on Naboo to the spacers.<ref name="SWG:Gc" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wire was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]].<ref name="SWG:Gc" /> The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Wire was added to the game with the third chapter of the "[[W:c:swg:Secrets of the Syren|Secrets of the Syren]]" quest line, released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 19 Notes for 29 June 2005|Publish 19]]," on [[June 29]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Update Notes: Publish 19.0 - June 29th, 2005">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=757|text=Update Notes: Publish 19.0 - June 29th, 2005}}</ref> The "Secrets of the Syren" story arc was removed from the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]], due to the major changes planed for Rori with the introduction of the [[Battle of Restuss]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter Archive 2006">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64186&resource=publish|text=Chapter Archive 2006}}</ref>
